title: File Type Detector
story: Your file manager needs to show different icons for different file types. Given a filename like "photo.jpg", it should detect the type from the extension and return an enum variant with that extension as data.
why: Enums plus string inspection create a clean classifier that turns raw filenames into typed values.
analogy: A filename extension is like the last name of a person � it tells you what family they belong to. The detector is like a census worker who sorts people by family name into categories.
try_it: Add `Audio(ext: Str)` and `Archive(ext: Str)` variants. Detect mp3/wav as Audio and zip/rar as Archive. Write a function `can_preview` that returns true for Image, Audio, and Video but false for everything else. Detect 6 different files.
tips: Use multiple `if` branches to classify � check most specific cases first
The `Unknown` variant acts as a safety net for anything you haven't categorized yet
Carry the extension in the variant so you can display it later without re-parsing the filename
common_mistakes: Checking extensions in the wrong order � if `.jpg` and `.jpeg2000` are both checked, be careful
Forgetting the `Unknown` variant � every classification function needs a fallback
